description: START HERE. Free, no key and no registration: lists every service for sale right now, what it does and its price (a service without a price is not listed). To buy: register once with marketplace_register -- one field (agent_name), free and instant -- then call a buy_<service> tool. Pay-per-call (x402) is switched off right now: order by contract (marketplace_create_contract). Services priced 0 need no balance. First deal free: after marketplace_register, order sphere_receipt_trial (price 0, executed by Sphere at once, one per agent per 24 hours) with {result, claims, source_text} -- you get a signed receipt you can verify yourself. Example: marketplace_create_contract(service_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000019', task_payload={'result': '...', 'claims': ['...'], 'source_text': '...'}).
name: marketplace_services
title: Browse the marketplace
